LESSON: ULUMUL QUR’AN

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Qur’an
Topic 1.1: Ulumul Qur’an

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Ulumul Qur’an. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why was the Qur’an revealed to mankind?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. state the reasons for the revelation of the Qur’an as a guide to mankind
2. describe the stages of the revelation of the Qur’an as a sign of mercy to mankind
3. explain the reasons for the revelation of the Qur’an in portions for ease of its implementation
4. value the Qur’an as a book of guidance to mankind

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: ULUMUL QUR’AN
This lesson teaches Ulumul Qur’an for Grade 7 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

STUDY STEPS
1. state the reasons for the revelation of the Qur’an as a guide to mankind
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. describe the stages of the revelation of the Qur’an as a sign of mercy to mankind
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. explain the reasons for the revelation of the Qur’an in portions for ease of its implementation
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
4. value the Qur’an as a book of guidance to mankind
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Ulumul Qur’an using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Ulumul Qur’an above.
2. Explain Ulumul Qur’an to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Ulumul Qur’an.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Ulumul Qur’an with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Ulumul Qur’an important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why was the Qur’an revealed to mankind?
2. How does the Qur’an guide mankind?
3. How did Muslims benefit from the revelation of the Qur’an in portions?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. state the reasons for the revelation of the Qur’an as a guide to mankind
2. describe the stages of the revelation of the Qur’an as a sign of mercy to mankind
3. explain the reasons for the revelation of the Qur’an in portions for ease of its implementation
4. value the Qur’an as a book of guidance to mankind

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
